title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12120)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers preservative treatment of wood panel products and the raw materials, such as stiles, battens, veneers and wood chips ( particles ) used to manufacture these products against biological damage; that is, sap-stain, wood rotting fungi, tefmite, insects, marine borers and bacteria in order to obtain satisfactory economic Ijfe.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
